description:
Fund the pool WITHOUT minting voting weight, with a name on the record.

Does not raise the price of joining (weight is priced against contributed sats only), but does enlarge every payout, since the payout is a fraction of the whole pool.

`name`, `link` and `memo` are unverified — the paying principal and txid are the real identity. SPENDS REAL sBTC AND IS FINAL: no refund path exists.

Metered against the wallet's `sats` spending limit before signing.

Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

memo.description: Optional free-form note on the record (ASCII, ≤128 chars)

name.description: Sponsor name as it should be attributed (ASCII, ≤40 chars)

sats.description: Amount of sBTC to sponsor, in sats (must meet the treasury's minimum)

name: legion_sponsor
